```{r}
############################################################
# 0) CLEAN START + LOAD PACKAGES + LOAD DATA
#    (copy/paste as the first cell in your R notebook)
############################################################

rm(list = ls())

# Avoid legacy plyr masking tidyverse verbs
if ("package:dplyr" %in% search()) {
  detach("package:dplyr", unload = TRUE, character.only = TRUE)
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

# ---- Working directory (project root for this analysis) ----
setwd("/SynologyDrive/PhD/Projects/SpringBloom2021/DataAnalysis_SpringBloom2021/Supplementary/Export_Import/")

# ---- Data inputs (one line each) ----
protein_final          <- read_csv("../../Figure_04/Data_Filtration/retained_protein_table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
retained_species       <- read_csv("../../Figure_04/Data_Filtration/retained_species.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
retained_species_dates <- read_csv("../../Figure_04/Data_Filtration/retained_species_dates.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

gene_dat <- read_csv("../../../Data/Gene_Data/Final_Data/Gene_Table.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

transporter_table_raw <- read_csv(
  "../../../Data/KEGG_Category_Data/Final_Data/KEGG_Transporter_Categories_Curated.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# ---- (Optional) quick sanity prints ----
glimpse(protein_final)
glimpse(retained_species)
glimpse(retained_species_dates)
glimpse(gene_dat)
glimpse(transporter_table_raw)

```


```{r}
############################################################
# 1) DATA MANIPULATION + CONSTRUCTION OF THE TWO MAIN TABLES
#
# OUTPUT TABLES:
#   (A) gene_retained_annot
#       - genes from retained species only
#       - transporter ontology added by KEGG_ID (KO)
#       - Group_For_Plots added
#       - KEGG_Subcategory added (mapped from proteomics annotations)
#
#   (B) protein_retained_annot
#       - proteins restricted to the retained species×date universe
#       - transporter ontology added by KEGG_ID (KO)
#       - already contains Group_For_Plots + KEGG_Subcategory from protein_final
#
#   - strict enforcement of retained species×date universe for proteomics
#   - one-row-per-KO transporter ontology to prevent double counting
#   - explicit joins by Species_ID / Date / Protein_ID / KEGG_ID
############################################################

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# A) Collapse transporter ontology to ONE ROW PER KO (KEGG_ID)
#
# Rationale:
#   Some KOs appear multiple times in the curated transporter table
#   (e.g. due to alternative hierarchical placements).
#   To avoid double counting, we collapse to one row per KO and
#   merge duplicated annotations by concatenating unique values
#   with ";" for each annotation category.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

transporter_table_final <- transporter_table_raw %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  group_by(KEGG_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Transporter_Family = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Transporter_Family))), collapse = ";"),
    major_group        = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(major_group))), collapse = ";"),
    brite_id           = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(brite_id))), collapse = ";"),
    brite_name         = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(brite_name))), collapse = ";"),
    Path_L1            = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Path_L1))), collapse = ";"),
    Path_L2            = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Path_L2))), collapse = ";"),
    Path_L3            = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Path_L3))), collapse = ";"),
    Path_L4            = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Path_L4))), collapse = ";"),
    Substrate_Group   = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Substrate_Group))), collapse = ";"),
    Substrate_Category = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Substrate_Category))), collapse = ";"),
    Path_L5            = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Path_L5))), collapse = ";"),
    path               = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(path))), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# B) Build the *retained* proteomics table (species×date enforced)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
protein_retained_annot <- protein_final %>%
  semi_join(retained_species_dates %>% select(Species_ID, Date), by = c("Species_ID", "Date")) %>%
  left_join(gene_dat %>% select(Protein_ID, KEGG_ID) %>% distinct()) %>%
  left_join(transporter_table_final, by = c("KEGG_ID","Substrate_Category","Transporter_Family"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# C) Build the *retained* gene table (species enforced)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
gene_retained_annot <- gene_dat %>%
  semi_join(retained_species %>% select(Species_ID), by = "Species_ID") %>%
  left_join(transporter_table_final, by = "KEGG_ID") %>%
  left_join(retained_species %>% select(Species_ID, Group_For_Plots), by = c("Species_ID"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# D) Add KEGG_Subcategory to genes using a KEGG_ID -> KEGG_Subcategory map
#    Source-of-truth: protein_retained_annot (observed, retained, annotated proteome)
#    If a KEGG_ID maps to multiple KEGG_Subcategory strings, collapse with ";"
# ------------------------------------------------------------
kegg_subcat_map <- protein_retained_annot %>%
  select(KEGG_ID, KEGG_Subcategory) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ID), !is.na(KEGG_Subcategory), KEGG_ID != "Unclassified") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(KEGG_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    KEGG_Subcategory = paste(sort(unique(KEGG_Subcategory)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gene_retained_annot <- gene_retained_annot %>%
  left_join(kegg_subcat_map, by = "KEGG_ID")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# E) Minimal sanity checks (recommended)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Proteomics: every row must be within retained species×date universe
stopifnot(
  nrow(anti_join(
    protein_retained_annot %>% distinct(Species_ID, Date),
    retained_species_dates %>% distinct(Species_ID, Date),
    by = c("Species_ID", "Date")
  )) == 0
)

# 2) Genes: every species must be in retained_species
stopifnot(
  nrow(anti_join(
    gene_retained_annot %>% distinct(Species_ID),
    retained_species %>% distinct(Species_ID),
    by = "Species_ID"
  )) == 0
)

# 3) Quick coverage diagnostics
message("Proteins retained: ", nrow(protein_retained_annot))
message("Species in proteomics retained: ", n_distinct(protein_retained_annot$Species_ID))
message("Genes retained: ", nrow(gene_retained_annot))
message("Species in genes retained: ", n_distinct(gene_retained_annot$Species_ID))

# 4) Confirm KEGG_Subcategory was added to genes (not necessarily complete)
gene_retained_annot %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes = n(),
    n_with_kegg_id = sum(!is.na(KEGG_ID) & KEGG_ID != "Unclassified"),
    n_with_subcat  = sum(!is.na(KEGG_Subcategory)),
    prop_subcat_among_kegg = n_with_subcat / n_with_kegg_id
  )

# Optional: inspect final tables
glimpse(protein_retained_annot)
glimpse(gene_retained_annot)
```


```{r}
############################################################
# TRANSPORTER DIRECTION CLASSIFICATION
#
# Required objects already present in the R environment:
#   1. gene_retained_annot
#   2. protein_retained_annot
#
# Final mutually exclusive classes:
#   - ABC import
#   - ABC efflux
#   - Unsure ABC
#   - Non-ABC import
#   - Non-ABC efflux
#   - Unsure non-ABC
#
# Interpretation:
#   - "Genetic potential" contains all encoded transporter
#     Protein_IDs in gene_retained_annot.
#
#   - "Detected proteome" contains the same type of transporter
#     Protein_IDs, but only when Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0
#     on at least one sampling date.
#
# Important:
#   Direction is assigned conservatively. Generic ATPases,
#   permeases, channels, antiporters, and transporters without
#   explicit directional evidence remain "Unsure".
############################################################


############################################################
# 0) CHECK INPUTS AND DEFINE OUTPUT DIRECTORY
############################################################

stopifnot(
  exists("gene_retained_annot"),
  exists("protein_retained_annot")
)

required_gene_columns <- c(
  "Species_ID", "Protein_ID", "KEGG_ID",
  "KEGG_Annotation", "Transporter_Family",
  "Path_L2", "Path_L3", "Path_L4", "Path_L5", "path",
  "Substrate_Group", "Substrate_Category",
  "Group_For_Plots"
)

required_protein_columns <- c(
  "Date", "Species_ID", "Protein_ID", "KEGG_ID",
  "Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm",
  "Group_For_Plots", "TrophicIndex"
)

stopifnot(
  all(required_gene_columns %in% names(gene_retained_annot)),
  all(required_protein_columns %in% names(protein_retained_annot))
)

output_dir <- "Transporter_Direction_Output"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)


############################################################
# 1) HELPER FUNCTIONS AND FINAL CLASS ORDER
############################################################

# Collapse multiple non-empty annotations into one string.
collapse_unique <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse = "; ")
}

# Return the first non-missing value while preserving its type.
first_non_missing <- function(x) {
  valid <- which(!is.na(x))

  if (length(valid) == 0) {
    return(x[NA_integer_][1])
  }

  x[valid[1]]
}

class_levels <- c(
  "ABC import",
  "ABC efflux",
  "Unsure ABC",
  "Non-ABC import",
  "Non-ABC efflux",
  "Unsure non-ABC"
)

group_levels <- c(
  "Oligotroph",
  "Intermediate",
  "Copiotroph"
)


############################################################
# 2) BUILD ONE TRANSPORTER CATALOGUE PER KEGG ORTHOLOGY
#
# Transporter_Family determines ABC versus non-ABC.
#
# Path_L2 to Path_L5 and path provide the KEGG transporter
# hierarchy used to determine import versus efflux.
############################################################

ko_annotations <- gene_retained_annot %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Transporter_Family),
    str_trim(Transporter_Family) != "",
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID != "",
    KEGG_ID != "Unclassified"
  ) %>%
  group_by(KEGG_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Transporter_Family = collapse_unique(Transporter_Family),
    KEGG_Annotation    = collapse_unique(KEGG_Annotation),
    Path_L2            = collapse_unique(Path_L2),
    Path_L3            = collapse_unique(Path_L3),
    Path_L4            = collapse_unique(Path_L4),
    Path_L5            = collapse_unique(Path_L5),
    path               = collapse_unique(path),
    Substrate_Group    = collapse_unique(Substrate_Group),
    Substrate_Category = collapse_unique(Substrate_Category),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(ko_annotations) == n_distinct(ko_annotations$KEGG_ID)
)


############################################################
# 3) RECORD HOW OFTEN EACH TRANSPORTER KO OCCURS
#
# These counts help prioritize the later manual review:
#   - KOs detected in the proteome are most important.
#   - Frequently encoded KOs affect more MAGs/proteins.
############################################################

ko_genome_usage <- gene_retained_annot %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Transporter_Family),
    str_trim(Transporter_Family) != "",
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID != "",
    KEGG_ID != "Unclassified"
  ) %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, Protein_ID, KEGG_ID) %>%
  group_by(KEGG_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Encoded_ProteinIDs = n(),
    N_Genomes_Encoded    = n_distinct(Species_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ko_proteome_usage <- protein_retained_annot %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID != "",
    KEGG_ID != "Unclassified",
    !is.na(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm),
    Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0
  ) %>%
  semi_join(ko_annotations, by = "KEGG_ID") %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, Protein_ID, KEGG_ID) %>%
  group_by(KEGG_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Detected_ProteinIDs = n(),
    N_Genomes_Detected    = n_distinct(Species_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
# 4) DEFINE CONSERVATIVE DIRECTIONAL EVIDENCE
#
# Efflux evidence:
#   Only explicit outward-transport terms are used.
#   Generic "transporter", "permease", "ATPase", "antiporter",
#   or a transported substrate alone are NOT sufficient.
#
# Import evidence:
#   Explicit uptake/import terms, substrate-binding proteins,
#   outer-membrane uptake receptors, PTS systems, and the five
#   established KEGG prokaryotic ABC-importer branches.
#
# If both import and efflux evidence are found, the KO remains
# Unsure so it can be checked manually.
############################################################

efflux_pattern <- regex(
  paste(
    c(
      "\\befflux\\b",
      "\\befflux pump\\b",
      "\\bexporter\\b",
      "\\bexport system\\b",
      "\\bexport protein\\b",
      "\\bexporting atpase\\b",
      "\\bextrusion\\b",
      "\\bmultidrug\\b",
      "\\bdrug resistance\\b",
      "\\bantibiotic resistance\\b",
      "\\bantimicrobial resistance\\b",
      "\\btoxin exporter\\b",
      "\\btoxin extrusion\\b",
      "\\bcation efflux\\b",
      "\\bmetal efflux\\b",
      "\\bheavy metal resistance\\b",
      "\\barsenite exporter\\b",
      "\\barsenical pump\\b",
      "\\bchromate exporter\\b",
      "\\bfluoride exporter\\b",
      "\\bbacteriocin exporter\\b",
      "\\blantibiotic exporter\\b"
    ),
    collapse = "|"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

import_pattern <- regex(
  paste(
    c(
      "\\bimporter\\b",
      "\\bimport system\\b",
      "\\buptake\\b",
      "\\binflux\\b",
      "substrate[- ]binding protein",
      "solute[- ]binding protein",
      "outer ?membrane receptor",
      "\\bsymporter\\b"
    ),
    collapse = "|"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

# KEGG prokaryotic ABC branches that primarily describe
# nutrient and ion import systems.
abc_importer_branch_pattern <- regex(
  paste(
    c(
      "saccharide.*polyol.*lipid transporters",
      "phosphate.*amino acid transporters",
      "peptide.*nickel transporters",
      "metallic cation.*iron[- ]siderophore.*vitamin b12 transporters",
      "mineral.*organic ion transporters"
    ),
    collapse = "|"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

# MFS "Drug transporters" are provisionally classified as
# efflux because this branch represents drug-efflux systems.
mfs_drug_branch_pattern <- regex(
  "drug transporters",
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

# PTS systems mediate uptake and phosphorylation of substrates.
pts_pattern <- regex(
  "phosphotransferase system|\\bPTS\\b",
  ignore_case = TRUE
)


############################################################
# 5) AUTOMATIC KO-LEVEL CLASSIFICATION
############################################################

ko_auto <- ko_annotations %>%
  left_join(ko_genome_usage, by = "KEGG_ID") %>%
  left_join(ko_proteome_usage, by = "KEGG_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        N_Encoded_ProteinIDs,
        N_Genomes_Encoded,
        N_Detected_ProteinIDs,
        N_Genomes_Detected
      ),
      ~replace_na(.x, 0L)
    ),

    # Combine all informative annotation fields for searching.
    Search_Text = str_squish(str_c(
      coalesce(Path_L2, ""),
      coalesce(Path_L3, ""),
      coalesce(Path_L4, ""),
      coalesce(Path_L5, ""),
      coalesce(path, ""),
      coalesce(KEGG_Annotation, ""),
      sep = " | "
    )),

    # ABC can also occur in a semicolon-collapsed annotation.
    ABC_Flag = str_detect(
      Transporter_Family,
      regex("(^|;\\s*)ABC(\\s*;|$)", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ),

    Mechanism = if_else(
      ABC_Flag,
      "ABC",
      "Non-ABC"
    ),

    # A semicolon together with ABC indicates that the same KO
    # received more than one family annotation.
    Mechanism_Conflict = ABC_Flag &
      str_detect(Transporter_Family, fixed(";")),

    # Explicit outward-transport annotation.
    Explicit_Efflux = str_detect(
      Search_Text,
      efflux_pattern
    ),

    # MFS drug-transporter branch provides additional efflux evidence.
    MFS_Drug_Efflux = Mechanism == "Non-ABC" &
      str_detect(coalesce(Path_L3, ""), mfs_drug_branch_pattern),

    Efflux_Evidence = Explicit_Efflux | MFS_Drug_Efflux,

    # Explicit import or uptake description.
    Explicit_Import = str_detect(
      Search_Text,
      import_pattern
    ),

    # KEGG ABC nutrient/ion importer branches.
    ABC_Importer_Branch = Mechanism == "ABC" &
      str_detect(
        coalesce(Path_L3, ""),
        abc_importer_branch_pattern
      ),

    # Phosphotransferase systems are non-ABC uptake systems.
    PTS_Import = Mechanism == "Non-ABC" &
      str_detect(Search_Text, pts_pattern),

    Import_Evidence = Explicit_Import |
      ABC_Importer_Branch |
      PTS_Import,

    # Conservative six-class automatic assignment.
    Auto_Class = case_when(
      Mechanism_Conflict ~ "Unsure ABC",

      Efflux_Evidence & Import_Evidence &
        Mechanism == "ABC" ~ "Unsure ABC",

      Efflux_Evidence & Import_Evidence &
        Mechanism == "Non-ABC" ~ "Unsure non-ABC",

      Efflux_Evidence &
        Mechanism == "ABC" ~ "ABC efflux",

      Efflux_Evidence &
        Mechanism == "Non-ABC" ~ "Non-ABC efflux",

      Import_Evidence &
        Mechanism == "ABC" ~ "ABC import",

      Import_Evidence &
        Mechanism == "Non-ABC" ~ "Non-ABC import",

      Mechanism == "ABC" ~ "Unsure ABC",

      TRUE ~ "Unsure non-ABC"
    ),

    Auto_Rule = case_when(
      Mechanism_Conflict ~
        "Conflicting ABC/non-ABC family annotations",

      Efflux_Evidence & Import_Evidence ~
        "Both import and efflux evidence detected",

      Explicit_Efflux ~
        "Explicit efflux/export annotation",

      MFS_Drug_Efflux ~
        "KEGG MFS drug-transporter branch",

      Explicit_Import ~
        "Explicit import/uptake annotation",

      ABC_Importer_Branch ~
        "KEGG prokaryotic ABC-importer branch",

      PTS_Import ~
        "Phosphotransferase uptake system",

      TRUE ~
        "No unambiguous directional evidence"
    ),

    Review_Priority = case_when(
      N_Detected_ProteinIDs > 0 ~ 1L,
      N_Encoded_ProteinIDs > 0  ~ 2L,
      TRUE                      ~ 3L
    )
  )


############################################################
# 6) OPTIONAL MANUAL OVERRIDES
#
# On the first run, the curation CSV is created with an empty
# Manual_Class column.
#
# To revise a KO later:
#   1. Open Transporter_KO_Direction_Curation.csv
#   2. Enter one valid class into Manual_Class
#   3. Add an explanation under Manual_Notes
#   4. Save the CSV
#   5. Re-run this complete code block
#
# Do not edit Auto_Class. Manual_Class overrides Auto_Class.
############################################################

curation_path <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "Transporter_KO_Direction_Curation.csv"
)

if (file.exists(curation_path)) {

  previous_curation <- read_csv(
    curation_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  if (!"Manual_Class" %in% names(previous_curation)) {
    previous_curation$Manual_Class <- NA_character_
  }

  if (!"Manual_Notes" %in% names(previous_curation)) {
    previous_curation$Manual_Notes <- NA_character_
  }

  manual_overrides <- previous_curation %>%
    transmute(
      KEGG_ID = as.character(KEGG_ID),

      Manual_Class = na_if(
        str_trim(as.character(Manual_Class)),
        ""
      ),

      Manual_Notes = na_if(
        str_trim(as.character(Manual_Notes)),
        ""
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(KEGG_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

} else {

  manual_overrides <- tibble(
    KEGG_ID = character(),
    Manual_Class = character(),
    Manual_Notes = character()
  )
}

# Stop if a manually entered class does not exactly match one
# of the six permitted class names.
invalid_manual_classes <- setdiff(
  na.omit(unique(manual_overrides$Manual_Class)),
  class_levels
)

if (length(invalid_manual_classes) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Invalid Manual_Class value(s): ",
    paste(invalid_manual_classes, collapse = ", "),
    "\nAllowed values are: ",
    paste(class_levels, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

ko_catalogue <- ko_auto %>%
  left_join(manual_overrides, by = "KEGG_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Final_Class = coalesce(
      Manual_Class,
      Auto_Class
    ),

    Needs_Review = Final_Class %in% c(
      "Unsure ABC",
      "Unsure non-ABC"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Review_Priority,
    Needs_Review,
    Final_Class,
    desc(N_Detected_ProteinIDs),
    desc(N_Encoded_ProteinIDs),
    KEGG_ID
  ) %>%
  select(
    KEGG_ID,
    Final_Class,
    Manual_Class,
    Auto_Class,
    Mechanism,
    Needs_Review,
    Auto_Rule,
    Manual_Notes,
    Review_Priority,
    N_Encoded_ProteinIDs,
    N_Genomes_Encoded,
    N_Detected_ProteinIDs,
    N_Genomes_Detected,
    Transporter_Family,
    Substrate_Group,
    Substrate_Category,
    Path_L2,
    Path_L3,
    Path_L4,
    Path_L5,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    path,
    Mechanism_Conflict,
    Efflux_Evidence,
    Import_Evidence,
    Explicit_Efflux,
    MFS_Drug_Efflux,
    Explicit_Import,
    ABC_Importer_Branch,
    PTS_Import,
    Search_Text
  )

stopifnot(
  all(ko_catalogue$Final_Class %in% class_levels),
  nrow(ko_catalogue) == n_distinct(ko_catalogue$KEGG_ID)
)

# This file can be edited manually and safely reused.
write_csv(
  ko_catalogue,
  curation_path,
  na = ""
)


############################################################
# 7) CREATE THE GENETIC-POTENTIAL TRANSPORTER TABLE
#
# One row represents one encoded transporter Protein_ID.
############################################################

ko_classification_key <- ko_catalogue %>%
  select(
    KEGG_ID,
    Final_Class,
    Auto_Class,
    Manual_Class,
    Auto_Rule,
    Manual_Notes,
    Needs_Review
  )

gene_transporter_ids <- gene_retained_annot %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Transporter_Family),
    str_trim(Transporter_Family) != "",
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID != "",
    KEGG_ID != "Unclassified"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    ko_classification_key,
    by = "KEGG_ID"
  ) %>%
  select(
    Species_ID,
    Contig_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    KEGG_ID,
    Group_For_Plots,
    Final_Class,
    Auto_Class,
    Manual_Class,
    Auto_Rule,
    Manual_Notes,
    Needs_Review,
    Transporter_Family,
    Substrate_Group,
    Substrate_Category,
    Path_L2,
    Path_L3,
    Path_L4,
    Path_L5,
    KEGG_Annotation,
    path
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    KEGG_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


############################################################
# 8) CREATE THE DETECTED-PROTEOME TRANSPORTER TABLE
#
# A Protein_ID is retained when normalized iBAQ is above zero
# on at least one date.
#
# Multiple positive dates are collapsed to one Protein_ID row.
############################################################

protein_transporter_positive_rows <- protein_retained_annot %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm),
    Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0,
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID != "",
    KEGG_ID != "Unclassified"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    ko_classification_key,
    by = "KEGG_ID"
  )

protein_transporter_ids <- protein_transporter_positive_rows %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    KEGG_ID,
    Final_Class,
    Auto_Class,
    Manual_Class,
    Auto_Rule,
    Manual_Notes,
    Needs_Review
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Group_For_Plots = first_non_missing(Group_For_Plots),
    TrophicIndex     = first_non_missing(TrophicIndex),

    Transporter_Family = collapse_unique(Transporter_Family),
    Substrate_Group    = collapse_unique(Substrate_Group),
    Substrate_Category = collapse_unique(Substrate_Category),
    Path_L2            = collapse_unique(Path_L2),
    Path_L3            = collapse_unique(Path_L3),
    Path_L4            = collapse_unique(Path_L4),
    Path_L5            = collapse_unique(Path_L5),
    KEGG_Annotation    = collapse_unique(KEGG_Annotation),
    path               = collapse_unique(path),

    N_Dates_Detected = n_distinct(Date),

    Mean_IBAQ_Norm_Positive = mean(
      Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Maximum_IBAQ_Norm = max(
      Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Sum_IBAQ_Norm_Across_Dates = sum(
      Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
# 9) CHECK THAT EACH PROTEIN_ID HAS ONLY ONE CLASS
############################################################

gene_class_conflicts <- gene_transporter_ids %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, Protein_ID, Final_Class) %>%
  count(Species_ID, Protein_ID, name = "N_Classes") %>%
  filter(N_Classes > 1)

protein_class_conflicts <- protein_transporter_ids %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, Protein_ID, Final_Class) %>%
  count(Species_ID, Protein_ID, name = "N_Classes") %>%
  filter(N_Classes > 1)

if (nrow(gene_class_conflicts) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    gene_class_conflicts,
    file.path(output_dir, "CHECK_Gene_ProteinID_Class_Conflicts.csv")
  )

  stop(
    "Some encoded Protein_IDs have more than one transporter class. ",
    "See CHECK_Gene_ProteinID_Class_Conflicts.csv."
  )
}

if (nrow(protein_class_conflicts) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    protein_class_conflicts,
    file.path(output_dir, "CHECK_Protein_ProteinID_Class_Conflicts.csv")
  )

  stop(
    "Some detected Protein_IDs have more than one transporter class. ",
    "See CHECK_Protein_ProteinID_Class_Conflicts.csv."
  )
}


############################################################
# 10) CONFIRM THAT DETECTED TRANSPORTERS EXIST IN THE GENOME
############################################################

detected_not_in_genome <- protein_transporter_ids %>%
  select(Species_ID, Protein_ID, KEGG_ID) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  anti_join(
    gene_transporter_ids %>%
      select(Species_ID, Protein_ID, KEGG_ID) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = c("Species_ID", "Protein_ID", "KEGG_ID")
  )

if (nrow(detected_not_in_genome) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    detected_not_in_genome,
    file.path(output_dir, "CHECK_Detected_Transporters_Not_In_Gene_Table.csv")
  )

  stop(
    "Some detected transporter Protein_IDs were not found in ",
    "gene_transporter_ids. See the exported CHECK file."
  )
}


############################################################
# 11) BUILD THE SPECIES METADATA TABLE
############################################################

species_group_check <- gene_retained_annot %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group_For_Plots)) %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, Group_For_Plots) %>%
  count(Species_ID, name = "N_Groups") %>%
  filter(N_Groups > 1)

if (nrow(species_group_check) > 0) {
  stop("At least one Species_ID has multiple Group_For_Plots values.")
}

species_trophic_index <- protein_retained_annot %>%
  group_by(Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    TrophicIndex = first_non_missing(TrophicIndex),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

species_key <- gene_retained_annot %>%
  group_by(Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Group_For_Plots = first_non_missing(Group_For_Plots),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    species_trophic_index,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Trophic_Group = case_when(
      Group_For_Plots %in% c("Oligo_like", "Oligotroph") ~
        "Oligotroph",

      Group_For_Plots == "Intermediate" ~
        "Intermediate",

      Group_For_Plots %in% c("Copio_like", "Copiotroph") ~
        "Copiotroph",

      TRUE ~ as.character(Group_For_Plots)
    ),

    Trophic_Group = factor(
      Trophic_Group,
      levels = group_levels
    )
  )


############################################################
# 12) FUNCTION TO CREATE IDENTICAL SPECIES-LEVEL SUMMARIES
#
# The same function is used for:
#   - all encoded transporter Protein_IDs;
#   - detected transporter Protein_IDs.
#
# This ensures directly comparable panels.
############################################################

make_species_transporter_summary <- function(
    transporter_ids,
    dataset_label,
    species_key,
    class_levels) {

  observed_counts <- transporter_ids %>%
    distinct(
      Species_ID,
      Protein_ID,
      Final_Class
    ) %>%
    count(
      Species_ID,
      Final_Class,
      name = "N_Transporter_ProteinIDs"
    )

  full_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
    Species_ID = species_key$Species_ID,
    Final_Class = class_levels
  )

  full_grid %>%
    left_join(
      observed_counts,
      by = c("Species_ID", "Final_Class")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      N_Transporter_ProteinIDs = replace_na(
        N_Transporter_ProteinIDs,
        0L
      )
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      species_key,
      by = "Species_ID"
    ) %>%
    group_by(Species_ID) %>%
    mutate(
      Total_Transporter_ProteinIDs =
        sum(N_Transporter_ProteinIDs),

      Proportion = if_else(
        Total_Transporter_ProteinIDs > 0,
        N_Transporter_ProteinIDs /
          Total_Transporter_ProteinIDs,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = dataset_label,

      Final_Class = factor(
        Final_Class,
        levels = class_levels
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      Trophic_Group,
      TrophicIndex,
      Species_ID,
      Final_Class
    )
}


############################################################
# 13) CREATE GENOME AND DETECTED-PROTEOME SUMMARIES
############################################################

genome_species_summary <- make_species_transporter_summary(
  transporter_ids = gene_transporter_ids,
  dataset_label = "Genetic potential",
  species_key = species_key,
  class_levels = class_levels
)

proteome_species_summary <- make_species_transporter_summary(
  transporter_ids = protein_transporter_ids,
  dataset_label = "Detected proteome",
  species_key = species_key,
  class_levels = class_levels
)

transporter_species_overview_long <- bind_rows(
  genome_species_summary,
  proteome_species_summary
) %>%
  mutate(
    Dataset = factor(
      Dataset,
      levels = c(
        "Genetic potential",
        "Detected proteome"
      )
    )
  )


############################################################
# 14) OPTIONAL WIDE-FORMAT SPECIES TABLE
############################################################

transporter_species_overview_wide <-
  transporter_species_overview_long %>%
  mutate(
    Class_Name = as.character(Final_Class),
    Class_Name = str_replace_all(
      Class_Name,
      "Non-ABC",
      "NonABC"
    ),
    Class_Name = str_replace_all(
      Class_Name,
      "[^A-Za-z0-9]+",
      "_"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Dataset,
    Species_ID,
    Trophic_Group,
    TrophicIndex,
    Total_Transporter_ProteinIDs,
    Class_Name,
    N_Transporter_ProteinIDs,
    Proportion
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Class_Name,
    values_from = c(
      N_Transporter_ProteinIDs,
      Proportion
    ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Class_Name}"
  )


############################################################
# 15) CREATE THE UNSURE LISTS FOR LATER MANUAL CHECKING
############################################################

unsure_ko_catalogue <- ko_catalogue %>%
  filter(
    Final_Class %in% c(
      "Unsure ABC",
      "Unsure non-ABC"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Review_Priority,
    desc(N_Detected_ProteinIDs),
    desc(N_Encoded_ProteinIDs),
    Final_Class,
    KEGG_ID
  )

unsure_gene_ids <- gene_transporter_ids %>%
  filter(
    Final_Class %in% c(
      "Unsure ABC",
      "Unsure non-ABC"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Final_Class,
    KEGG_ID,
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID
  )

unsure_protein_ids <- protein_transporter_ids %>%
  filter(
    Final_Class %in% c(
      "Unsure ABC",
      "Unsure non-ABC"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Final_Class,
    KEGG_ID,
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID
  )


############################################################
# 16) EXPORT ALL TABLES
############################################################

write_csv(
  gene_transporter_ids,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Transporter_GeneticPotential_ProteinIDs.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)

write_csv(
  protein_transporter_ids,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Transporter_DetectedProteome_ProteinIDs.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)

write_csv(
  transporter_species_overview_long,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Transporter_Species_Overview_Long.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)

write_csv(
  transporter_species_overview_wide,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Transporter_Species_Overview_Wide.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)

write_csv(
  unsure_ko_catalogue,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Transporter_Unsure_KOs.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)

write_csv(
  unsure_gene_ids,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Transporter_Unsure_GeneticPotential_ProteinIDs.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)

write_csv(
  unsure_protein_ids,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "Transporter_Unsure_DetectedProteome_ProteinIDs.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)


############################################################
# 17) FINAL DIAGNOSTICS
############################################################

message(
  "Retained species: ",
  n_distinct(species_key$Species_ID)
)

message(
  "Encoded transporter Protein_IDs: ",
  n_distinct(gene_transporter_ids$Protein_ID)
)

message(
  "Detected transporter Protein_IDs: ",
  n_distinct(protein_transporter_ids$Protein_ID)
)

message(
  "Transporter KOs requiring review: ",
  nrow(unsure_ko_catalogue)
)

message("\nKO classification:")
print(
  ko_catalogue %>%
    count(Final_Class, name = "N_KOs") %>%
    complete(
      Final_Class = class_levels,
      fill = list(N_KOs = 0L)
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(Final_Class, class_levels))
)

message("\nEncoded Protein_ID classification:")
print(
  gene_transporter_ids %>%
    distinct(Species_ID, Protein_ID, Final_Class) %>%
    count(Final_Class, name = "N_Encoded_ProteinIDs") %>%
    complete(
      Final_Class = class_levels,
      fill = list(N_Encoded_ProteinIDs = 0L)
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(Final_Class, class_levels))
)

message("\nDetected Protein_ID classification:")
print(
  protein_transporter_ids %>%
    distinct(Species_ID, Protein_ID, Final_Class) %>%
    count(Final_Class, name = "N_Detected_ProteinIDs") %>%
    complete(
      Final_Class = class_levels,
      fill = list(N_Detected_ProteinIDs = 0L)
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(Final_Class, class_levels))
)

message(
  "\nFinished. Tables saved in: ",
  normalizePath(output_dir)
)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# TRANSPORTER OVERVIEW FIGURE
#
# Builds three aligned nested/grouped bar plots:
#
#   A. Genetic potential
#      Distinct encoded transporter Protein_IDs per MAG
#
#   B. Detected proteome
#      Distinct transporter Protein_IDs detected at least once
#      with Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0
#
#   C. Protein abundance
#      For every species × date × transporter class:
#        sum Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm across proteins
#      Then:
#        mean across retained dates for each species
#        mean ± SD across species in each trophic group
#
# Required existing objects:
#   - gene_retained_annot
#   - protein_retained_annot
#   - ko_catalogue
#
# Optional but recommended existing object:
#   - retained_species_dates
#
# ko_catalogue must contain:
#   - KEGG_ID
#   - Final_Class
############################################################


############################################################
# 0) PACKAGES AND INPUT CHECKS
############################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

if (!requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop(
    "Package 'patchwork' is required to combine the panels.\n",
    "Install it once with: install.packages('patchwork')"
  )
}

stopifnot(
  exists("gene_retained_annot"),
  exists("protein_retained_annot"),
  exists("ko_catalogue")
)

required_gene_columns <- c(
  "Species_ID",
  "Protein_ID",
  "KEGG_ID",
  "Transporter_Family",
  "Group_For_Plots"
)

required_protein_columns <- c(
  "Date",
  "Species_ID",
  "Protein_ID",
  "KEGG_ID",
  "Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm",
  "Group_For_Plots",
  "TrophicIndex"
)

required_ko_columns <- c(
  "KEGG_ID",
  "Final_Class"
)

stopifnot(
  all(required_gene_columns %in% names(gene_retained_annot)),
  all(required_protein_columns %in% names(protein_retained_annot)),
  all(required_ko_columns %in% names(ko_catalogue))
)

figure_output_dir <- file.path(
  "Transporter_Direction_Output",
  "Transporter_Overview_Figure"
)

dir.create(
  figure_output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


############################################################
# 1) DEFINE ORDERS, LABELS, AND COLOURS
############################################################

class_levels <- c(
  "ABC import",
  "ABC efflux",
  "Unsure ABC",
  "Non-ABC import",
  "Non-ABC efflux",
  "Unsure non-ABC"
)

group_levels <- c(
  "Oligotroph",
  "Intermediate",
  "Copiotroph"
)

# Established trophic-group palette.
group_palette <- c(
  "Oligotroph"  = "#93C2E6",
  "Intermediate" = "#EDEAE9",
  "Copiotroph"   = "#BA5205"
)

# Two-line labels keep the six classes readable.
class_axis_labels <- c(
  "ABC import"          = "ABC\nimport",
  "ABC efflux"          = "ABC\nefflux",
  "Unsure ABC"          = "ABC\nunsure",
  "Non-ABC import"      = "Non-ABC\nimport",
  "Non-ABC efflux"      = "Non-ABC\nefflux",
  "Unsure non-ABC"      = "Non-ABC\nunsure"
)


############################################################
# 2) PREPARE THE FINAL KO CLASSIFICATION KEY
############################################################

ko_plot_key <- ko_catalogue %>%
  select(
    KEGG_ID,
    Final_Class
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_ID = as.character(KEGG_ID),
    Final_Class = as.character(Final_Class)
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# Validate that every KO has exactly one permitted class.
ko_class_conflicts <- ko_plot_key %>%
  count(KEGG_ID, name = "N_Classes") %>%
  filter(N_Classes > 1)

if (nrow(ko_class_conflicts) > 0) {
  stop(
    "At least one KEGG_ID has multiple Final_Class values ",
    "in ko_catalogue."
  )
}

invalid_classes <- setdiff(
  unique(ko_plot_key$Final_Class),
  class_levels
)

if (length(invalid_classes) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Unexpected Final_Class value(s): ",
    paste(invalid_classes, collapse = ", ")
  )
}


############################################################
# 3) BUILD THE SPECIES METADATA TABLE
############################################################

species_group_check <- gene_retained_annot %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group_For_Plots)) %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    Group_For_Plots
  ) %>%
  count(
    Species_ID,
    name = "N_Group_Values"
  ) %>%
  filter(N_Group_Values > 1)

if (nrow(species_group_check) > 0) {
  stop(
    "At least one Species_ID has multiple Group_For_Plots values."
  )
}

species_groups <- gene_retained_annot %>%
  group_by(Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Group_For_Plots = first(
      Group_For_Plots[!is.na(Group_For_Plots)],
      default = NA_character_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

species_trophic_index <- protein_retained_annot %>%
  group_by(Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    TrophicIndex = first(
      TrophicIndex[!is.na(TrophicIndex)],
      default = NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

species_plot_key <- species_groups %>%
  left_join(
    species_trophic_index,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Trophic_Group = case_when(
      Group_For_Plots %in% c(
        "Oligo_like",
        "Oligotroph"
      ) ~ "Oligotroph",

      Group_For_Plots == "Intermediate" ~
        "Intermediate",

      Group_For_Plots %in% c(
        "Copio_like",
        "Copiotroph"
      ) ~ "Copiotroph",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Trophic_Group = factor(
      Trophic_Group,
      levels = group_levels
    )
  )

if (any(is.na(species_plot_key$Trophic_Group))) {
  problem_species <- species_plot_key %>%
    filter(is.na(Trophic_Group))

  print(problem_species)

  stop(
    "Some species could not be assigned to ",
    "Oligotroph, Intermediate, or Copiotroph."
  )
}

message(
  "Species retained for plotting: ",
  n_distinct(species_plot_key$Species_ID)
)

group_sizes <- species_plot_key %>%
  count(
    Trophic_Group,
    name = "N_Species"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    Trophic_Group = factor(
      group_levels,
      levels = group_levels
    ),
    fill = list(N_Species = 0L)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Trophic_Group)

print(group_sizes)

group_legend_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(
    as.character(group_sizes$Trophic_Group),
    " (n = ",
    group_sizes$N_Species,
    ")"
  ),
  as.character(group_sizes$Trophic_Group)
)


############################################################
# 4) PANEL A: GENETIC POTENTIAL
#
# Count every encoded transporter Protein_ID once per species.
############################################################

genome_transporter_ids <- gene_retained_annot %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Transporter_Family),
    str_trim(Transporter_Family) != "",
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID != "",
    KEGG_ID != "Unclassified"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    ko_plot_key,
    by = "KEGG_ID"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    Final_Class
  )

# Check that no Protein_ID has multiple classes.
genome_class_conflicts <- genome_transporter_ids %>%
  count(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    name = "N_Classes"
  ) %>%
  filter(N_Classes > 1)

if (nrow(genome_class_conflicts) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    genome_class_conflicts,
    file.path(
      figure_output_dir,
      "CHECK_Genome_ProteinID_Class_Conflicts.csv"
    )
  )

  stop(
    "Some encoded Protein_IDs have multiple classes. ",
    "See CHECK_Genome_ProteinID_Class_Conflicts.csv."
  )
}

# Observed species-level counts.
genome_species_observed <- genome_transporter_ids %>%
  count(
    Species_ID,
    Final_Class,
    name = "Species_Value"
  )

# Add all missing species × class combinations as zero.
species_class_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  Species_ID = species_plot_key$Species_ID,
  Final_Class = class_levels
)

genome_species_values <- species_class_grid %>%
  left_join(
    genome_species_observed,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Final_Class"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_Value = replace_na(
      Species_Value,
      0L
    ),
    Panel = "A. Genetic potential",
    N_Retained_Dates = NA_integer_,
    Total_Abundance_Across_Dates = NA_real_
  )


############################################################
# 5) CLASSIFY POSITIVE PROTEOME ROWS
#
# These rows are used for both:
#   B. Number of distinct detected Protein_IDs
#   C. Summed normalized iBAQ
############################################################

protein_positive_classified <- protein_retained_annot %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm),
    Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm > 0,
    !is.na(KEGG_ID),
    KEGG_ID != "",
    KEGG_ID != "Unclassified"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    ko_plot_key,
    by = "KEGG_ID"
  ) %>%
  select(
    Date,
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    KEGG_ID,
    Final_Class,
    Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm
  )

# A Protein_ID should occur no more than once per species and date.
protein_date_duplicates <- protein_positive_classified %>%
  count(
    Species_ID,
    Date,
    Protein_ID,
    name = "N_Rows"
  ) %>%
  filter(N_Rows > 1)

if (nrow(protein_date_duplicates) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    protein_date_duplicates,
    file.path(
      figure_output_dir,
      "CHECK_ProteinID_Date_Duplicates.csv"
    )
  )

  stop(
    "Some Protein_IDs occur more than once per species-date. ",
    "See CHECK_ProteinID_Date_Duplicates.csv."
  )
}


############################################################
# 6) PANEL B: DETECTED TRANSPORTER PROTEINS
#
# Count every Protein_ID once if its normalized iBAQ was above
# zero on at least one retained date.
############################################################

detected_transporter_ids <- protein_positive_classified %>%
  distinct(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    Final_Class
  )

detected_class_conflicts <- detected_transporter_ids %>%
  count(
    Species_ID,
    Protein_ID,
    name = "N_Classes"
  ) %>%
  filter(N_Classes > 1)

if (nrow(detected_class_conflicts) > 0) {
  write_csv(
    detected_class_conflicts,
    file.path(
      figure_output_dir,
      "CHECK_Detected_ProteinID_Class_Conflicts.csv"
    )
  )

  stop(
    "Some detected Protein_IDs have multiple classes. ",
    "See CHECK_Detected_ProteinID_Class_Conflicts.csv."
  )
}

proteome_species_observed <- detected_transporter_ids %>%
  count(
    Species_ID,
    Final_Class,
    name = "Species_Value"
  )

proteome_species_values <- species_class_grid %>%
  left_join(
    proteome_species_observed,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Final_Class"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_Value = replace_na(
      Species_Value,
      0L
    ),
    Panel = "B. Detected proteins",
    N_Retained_Dates = NA_integer_,
    Total_Abundance_Across_Dates = NA_real_
  )


############################################################
# 7) PREPARE THE VALID SPECIES × DATE UNIVERSE
#
# Missing transporter classes at otherwise valid species-dates
# must be filled with zero before temporal averaging.
#
# This prevents averaging only across dates where a transporter
# was detected, which would inflate its abundance.
############################################################

if (exists("retained_species_dates")) {

  valid_species_dates <- retained_species_dates %>%
    select(
      Species_ID,
      Date
    ) %>%
    distinct()

} else {

  warning(
    "retained_species_dates was not found. ",
    "Using species-date combinations present in ",
    "protein_retained_annot instead."
  )

  valid_species_dates <- protein_retained_annot %>%
    select(
      Species_ID,
      Date
    ) %>%
    distinct()
}

valid_species_dates <- valid_species_dates %>%
  semi_join(
    species_plot_key,
    by = "Species_ID"
  )

species_without_dates <- species_plot_key %>%
  select(Species_ID) %>%
  anti_join(
    valid_species_dates %>%
      distinct(Species_ID),
    by = "Species_ID"
  )


############################################################
# 8) PANEL C: SUMMED TRANSPORTER PROTEIN ABUNDANCE
#
# Step 1:
#   Sum normalized iBAQ across all transporter proteins within
#   each Species_ID × Date × Final_Class.
#
# Step 2:
#   Fill missing classes on valid dates with zero.
#
# Step 3:
#   Calculate the mean class abundance across dates for each
#   species. Thus, every species contributes one value to the
#   trophic-group comparison.
############################################################

protein_class_abundance_by_date <-
  protein_positive_classified %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    Date,
    Final_Class
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Class_Abundance = sum(
      Protein_Abundance_IBAQ_Norm,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    N_Detected_ProteinIDs = n_distinct(Protein_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

species_date_class_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
  valid_species_dates,
  Final_Class = class_levels
)

protein_class_abundance_complete <-
  species_date_class_grid %>%
  left_join(
    protein_class_abundance_by_date,
    by = c(
      "Species_ID",
      "Date",
      "Final_Class"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Class_Abundance = replace_na(
      Class_Abundance,
      0
    ),

    N_Detected_ProteinIDs = replace_na(
      N_Detected_ProteinIDs,
      0L
    )
  )

abundance_species_values <-
  protein_class_abundance_complete %>%
  group_by(
    Species_ID,
    Final_Class
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    # Value used in panel C:
    # mean of the within-date protein abundance sums.
    Species_Value = mean(
      Class_Abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # Retained for transparency and data export.
    Total_Abundance_Across_Dates = sum(
      Class_Abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    N_Retained_Dates = n_distinct(Date),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Panel = "C. Protein abundance"
  )


############################################################
# 9) COMBINE THE THREE SPECIES-LEVEL DATASETS
############################################################

transporter_figure_species_data <- bind_rows(
  genome_species_values,
  proteome_species_values,
  abundance_species_values
) %>%
  left_join(
    species_plot_key,
    by = "Species_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Panel = factor(
      Panel,
      levels = c(
        "A. Genetic potential",
        "B. Detected proteins",
        "C. Protein abundance"
      )
    ),

    Final_Class = factor(
      Final_Class,
      levels = class_levels
    ),

    Trophic_Group = factor(
      Trophic_Group,
      levels = group_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Panel,
    Trophic_Group,
    TrophicIndex,
    Species_ID,
    Final_Class
  )

# Every panel should contain all retained species and all classes.
expected_rows_per_panel <-
  n_distinct(species_plot_key$Species_ID) *
  length(class_levels)

panel_row_check <- transporter_figure_species_data %>%
  count(
    Panel,
    name = "N_Rows"
  )

print(panel_row_check)

stopifnot(
  all(panel_row_check$N_Rows == expected_rows_per_panel)
)


############################################################
# 10) CALCULATE TROPHIC-GROUP MEANS AND SD
#
# Species are the biological replicates.
#
# We deliberately do not sum or stack species because the
# trophic groups contain different numbers of species.
############################################################

transporter_figure_group_summary <-
  transporter_figure_species_data %>%
  group_by(
    Panel,
    Final_Class,
    Trophic_Group
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Species = n_distinct(Species_ID),

    Mean = mean(
      Species_Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    SD = sd(
      Species_Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Median = median(
      Species_Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Errorbar_Lower = pmax(
      0,
      Mean - SD
    ),

    Errorbar_Upper = Mean + SD,

    Panel = factor(
      Panel,
      levels = c(
        "A. Genetic potential",
        "B. Detected proteins",
        "C. Protein abundance"
      )
    ),

    Final_Class = factor(
      Final_Class,
      levels = class_levels
    ),

    Trophic_Group = factor(
      Trophic_Group,
      levels = group_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Panel,
    Final_Class,
    Trophic_Group
  )


############################################################
# 11) EXPORT THE EXACT PLOTTING DATA
############################################################

write_csv(
  transporter_figure_species_data,
  file.path(
    figure_output_dir,
    "Transporter_Figure_SpeciesLevel_Data.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)

write_csv(
  transporter_figure_group_summary,
  file.path(
    figure_output_dir,
    "Transporter_Figure_GroupSummary_Mean_SD.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)

write_csv(
  protein_class_abundance_complete,
  file.path(
    figure_output_dir,
    "Transporter_Abundance_BySpecies_Date_Class.csv"
  ),
  na = ""
)


############################################################
# 12) COMMON PLOT SETTINGS
############################################################

bar_dodge <- position_dodge(
  width = 0.82
)

common_theme <- theme_classic(
  base_size = 9
) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 10,
      hjust = 0
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 8,
      colour = "black"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      lineheight = 0.9,
      margin = margin(t = 4)
    ),

    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "top",

    legend.title = element_blank(),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),

    legend.key.width = grid::unit(
      0.9,
      "cm"
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 5,
      r = 8,
      b = 5,
      l = 6
    )
  )


############################################################
# 13) FUNCTION FOR THE THREE MATCHED BAR PLOTS
############################################################

make_transporter_panel <- function(
    summary_data,
    panel_name,
    panel_title,
    y_title,
    y_label_function) {

  plot_data <- summary_data %>%
    filter(Panel == panel_name)

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = Final_Class,
      y = Mean,
      fill = Trophic_Group
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = bar_dodge,
      width = 0.72,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.25
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = Errorbar_Lower,
        ymax = Errorbar_Upper
      ),
      position = bar_dodge,
      width = 0.18,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = group_palette,
      breaks = group_levels,
      labels = unname(
        group_legend_labels[group_levels]
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = class_levels,
      labels = class_axis_labels,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = y_label_function,
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0, 0.10)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = panel_title,
      x = "Transporter class",
      y = y_title
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    common_theme
}


############################################################
# 14) CREATE THE THREE PANELS
############################################################

plot_A <- make_transporter_panel(
  summary_data = transporter_figure_group_summary,
  panel_name = "A. Genetic potential",
  panel_title = "A   Genetic potential",
  y_title = "Encoded transporter genes\nper MAG (mean ± SD)",
  y_label_function = scales::label_number(
    accuracy = 1
  )
)

plot_B <- make_transporter_panel(
  summary_data = transporter_figure_group_summary,
  panel_name = "B. Detected proteins",
  panel_title = "B   Detected transporter proteins",
  y_title = "Detected transporter proteins\nper MAG (mean ± SD)",
  y_label_function = scales::label_number(
    accuracy = 1
  )
)

plot_C <- make_transporter_panel(
  summary_data = transporter_figure_group_summary,
  panel_name = "C. Protein abundance",
  panel_title = "C   Transporter protein abundance",
  y_title = paste0(
    "Summed normalized iBAQ per MAG and date\n",
    "(temporal mean; group mean ± SD)"
  ),
  y_label_function = scales::label_scientific(
    digits = 2
  )
)


############################################################
# 15) COMBINE THE PANELS
#
# The transporter-class labels are shown only below panel C
# because all three panels have identical x-axis positions.
############################################################

plot_A_combined <- plot_A +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

plot_B_combined <- plot_B +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

plot_C_combined <- plot_C +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

transporter_overview_figure <-
  patchwork::wrap_plots(
    plot_A_combined,
    plot_B_combined,
    plot_C_combined,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(
      1,
      1,
      1.15
    )
  )


############################################################
# 16) SAVE COMBINED AND INDIVIDUAL FIGURES
############################################################

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_output_dir,
    "Transporter_Overview_Genome_Proteome_Abundance.pdf"
  ),
  plot = transporter_overview_figure,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 9,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_output_dir,
    "Transporter_Overview_Genome_Proteome_Abundance.png"
  ),
  plot = transporter_overview_figure,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 9,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_output_dir,
    "Panel_A_Genetic_Potential.pdf"
  ),
  plot = plot_A,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 3.6,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_output_dir,
    "Panel_B_Detected_Proteins.pdf"
  ),
  plot = plot_B,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 3.6,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_output_dir,
    "Panel_C_Protein_Abundance.pdf"
  ),
  plot = plot_C,
  width = 9.5,
  height = 3.6,
  units = "in"
)


############################################################
# 17) FINAL DATA CHECKS AND DISPLAY
############################################################

message("\nSpecies represented in every panel:")

print(
  transporter_figure_species_data %>%
    distinct(
      Panel,
      Species_ID,
      Trophic_Group
    ) %>%
    count(
      Panel,
      Trophic_Group,
      name = "N_Species"
    )
)

message("\nGroup-level plotting values:")

print(
  transporter_figure_group_summary %>%
    select(
      Panel,
      Final_Class,
      Trophic_Group,
      N_Species,
      Mean,
      SD
    ),
  n = Inf
)

message(
  "\nFigure and plotting tables saved in:\n",
  normalizePath(figure_output_dir)
)

# Display the finished figure in RStudio.
transporter_overview_figure
```
